 All Previous Game of the Year Winners at The Game Awards
 18 November 2026
 by Sam Aberdeen 
 52 seconds ago 
 With The Game Awards 2026 set to take place on 10 December, we’re looking back at the long history of the show, mainly focusing on every Game of the Year and nominee in their respective years. Established in 2014 by Geoff Keighley, The Game Awards has risen to become the most watched awards show in the entertainment world, eclipsing the views for the Grammys and even the Oscars.
 Since we’re starting in 2014 from the inception of The Game Awards , we’ll be taking a look at every major Game of the Year winner along with the other nominees that competed against them.
